units.rawText: My first meeting with the Professor? It was pretty straightforward. I heard about the Oasis, came here, met the Professor... and then I was assigned to be the Oasis's guard.
units.displayText: My first meeting with the Professor? It was pretty straightforward. I heard about the Oasis, came here, met the Professor... and then I was assigned to be the Oasis's guard.

spans.text: My first meeting with the Professor? It was pretty straightforward. I heard about the Oasis, came here, met the Professor... and then I was assigned to be the Oasis's guard.

units.rawText: Was it really straightforward? Based on what I remember, you've been the instigator of many things that were far beyond my expectations, Sockdolager.
units.displayText: Was it really straightforward? Based on what I remember, you've been the instigator of many things that were far beyond my expectations, Sockdolager.

spans.text: Was it really straightforward? Based on what I remember, you've been the instigator of many things that were far beyond my expectations, Sockdolager.

units.rawText: For the ones I still remember, Sockdolager, you once captured an Entropy alive, wrapped it like a mummy, and brought it back.
units.displayText: For the ones I still remember, Sockdolager, you once captured an Entropy alive, wrapped it like a mummy, and brought it back.

spans.text: For the ones I still remember, Sockdolager, you once captured an Entropy alive, wrapped it like a mummy, and brought it back.

units.rawText: Ehehe... I just thought the Entropic was too strange to just be left behind, so I just did it.
units.displayText: Ehehe... I just thought the Entropic was too strange to just be left behind, so I just did it.

spans.text: Ehehe... I just thought the Entropic was too strange to just be left behind, so I just did it.

units.rawText: With the way you dispose of Entropics or contain them, while sensing danger before they even get close... it's no stretch of the imagination to say that your skills as a hunter have been invaluable to us.

units.rawText: Those are essential skills for a hunter like me. Well now, I'll keep scouting ahead for you, Professor.

units.rawText: Stay safe. I'll be waiting for your good news.
